fixture.terrain: Cesium CustomHeightmapTerrainProvider 16x16 deterministic local heights; ellipsoid reset provider
fixture.terrainCoverage: local custom heightmap tiles and ellipsoid reset; no network quantized-mesh tiles

switchComparison.timingBoundary: setStack promise completion and the separate stable-scene wait are observed independently; switch-to-settled wall time runs from just before setStack through the final ownership snapshot and includes those snapshot costs, so stage values are not summed as end-to-end time
switchComparison.stableSceneGate: existing waitForStableScene predicates: globe tiles loaded, latched DataSourceDisplay.ready, zero worker pending, stable camera and worker signature with advancing postRender for at least 1000 ms; current DataSourceDisplay.update true is now additionally required for comparison switches
switchComparison.checkpointScope: active source, provider cache/load counters, local heightmap request count, worker counters, pending ownership, and controller tile-memory estimate
switchComparison.streamedTileMemoryUnavailableReason: fixture uses local single-tile imagery and a custom heightmap provider, not streamed 3D tiles

currentUpdateObserver.requirement: each switch waits for the existing DataSourceDisplay.update result true, bound to unchanged public EntityCollection contents, data-source ownership revision, exact collection identities, and that completed frame; no extra update calls
